articles.title: Need to Know: Bruins vs. Predators
Save of the Season? Sharks' Askarov makes diving glove save to rob goal
DiPietro Posts First NHL Shutout, Honors Mom in 6-0 Bruins Win

out.detail: upper body injury, week to week after blocking a slap shot off his left arm

returning: detail: returns to the top line
away.summary: The Sharks (6-4-1) are projected to dress the same lineup as their previous game, with Adam Gaudette making his season debut on the fourth line and Collin Graf returning to the top line alongside Macklin Celebrini and Will Smith. Alex Nedeljkovic is projected to start in goal. Alexander Wennberg and Igor Chernyshov remain injured, while Luca Cagnoni is scratched.

home.summary: The Bruins (8-2-1) will dress the same 18 skaters they used in a 6-0 win against the Nashville Predators on Thursday. Jeremy Swayman is projected to start in goal, with Michael DiPietro as backup. The team has no reported injuries and is coming off a strong home performance.
